sentences.text:
Pradip Bag ..... Petitioner
 Sk. Zafarulla, Advocate

Vs.
State of Odisha ..... Opp. Party
 Mr. Debasis Tripathy, Aga
 Coram:
 Justice Savitri Ratho
 Order

This is the second application of the petitioner under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. connection with Tarava P.S. Case No.257 of 2022 corresponding to G.R. Case No.07 of 2023 where the accused is facing trial for commission of offences under Sections 363, 376 (2)
(n), 366 of IPC read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act.

2. In BLAPL No. 10435 of 2023, after considering the submissions of the learned counsel for the petitioner and the statement of the victim record under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., the petitioner had been granted interim bail for a period of four months.

3. Sk. Zafarulla, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that after expiry of the period of 4 months the petitioner has surrendered in the learned trial court without abusing the liberty granted to him.

Referring to the rejection order, he submits that the victim had appeared in the case through counsel and an affidavit had been filed on her behalf stating that she is residing in the house of the petitioner peacefully and does not want to proceed with the case and does not have any objection if the accused is released on bail.

Referring to the depositions of the informant (mother of the victim)
and the victim, he submits that neither the victim nor her mother are interested to proceed with the case as the victim is residing in the house of the petitioner.
4. List this matter on 27.11.2024 to enable Mr. Debasis Tripathy, learned Additional Government Advocate to obtain the case diary and instructions regarding the whereabouts of the victim.
